subject: DropFrame vendor onboarding & PO issuance (initial PO and SKU discrepancy)
messages:
From: Jill Torres <jill.torres@dropframe.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding - DropFrame (initial request)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. We're excited to get DropFrame set up as an approved vendor for Redwood. Attached is our standard onboarding packet and current W-9. Can you confirm the documents you need from us to get a PO issued and the typical lead time to receive a provisional PO number?

A few specifics on our side: we prefer net-45 billing, and our standard SKU bundle for the Redwood integration is DF-STD (standard) — we can also provide a premium SKU DF-PRE if needed.

Attachments: DropFrame_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF), DropFrame_W9.pdf (PDF)

Best,
Jill Torres
Head of Partnerships | DropFrame Media
jill.torres@dropframe.io
+1 415-555-0192

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Torres <jill.torres@dropframe.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - DropFrame (initial request)

Hi Jill — welcome and thanks for sending the packet.

Attached is Redwood's vendor onboarding checklist (filled) — please review the sections marked "billing contact" and "tax ID" to make sure everything matches your invoices. To issue a provisional PO we need the completed onboarding form (attached) and a current certificate of insurance for services over $25k. If you can send the COI and confirm billing email, procurement will provision a PO within 48 business hours.

For the SKU question: please confirm which SKU you'll bill us under (DF-STD or DF-PRE) for the initial integration work so we can match line items.

Attachments: RWI_vendor_onboarding_filled.pdf (PDF)

Next steps I will: loop in procurement to request the provisional PO once the COI and final billing contact are in.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Request to create provisional PO and spend cap

Chloe/Laura — following up on DropFrame onboarding. I can take the PO creation. Notes:
- Vendor has sent onboarding packet; waiting on COI.
- Proposed provisional PO: limit $45,000 (initial integration + first quarter of usage). If growth justifies, we'll request an increase during the QBR.
- Important: their original estimate referenced DF-STD but the SOW line items our ENG intake captured map to DF-PRE. We need the vendor to confirm SKU at billing time or we'll need a line-item correction on the invoice.

Created a procurement ticket: PROC-4821 (see link). I'll generate a provisional PO number once COI and billing contact confirmed.

Marcus
Procurement Manager

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Torres <jill.torres@dropframe.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-11T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: PO issued: provisional PO RWI-2025-7783 (please confirm SKU & acceptance of spend cap)

Hi Jill — quick update from procurement: we have issued a provisional purchase order for DropFrame. Details below:

PO number: RWI-2025-7783 (provisional)
Spend cap: $45,000 (initial period, locks until 2025-10-01 unless revised)
Attached: PO_RWI-2025-7783.pdf (PDF) — please include this PO number on all invoices.

One item to call out: procurement flagged that the SOW our ENG intake recorded maps to SKU DF-PRE, but your onboarding packet references DF-STD. Please confirm which SKU you will invoice under for the initial deliverable so we can align line items before you send an invoice. If you invoice the DF-STD SKU we will need a corrected invoice to reflect DF-PRE pricing or a written confirmation from you accepting DF-STD pricing under this PO.

Action items for DropFrame:
- Reply to this thread confirming accepted PO number and the SKU you will bill against.
- Attach COI if not already provided.
- If you plan to bill DF-PRE, send a short amended invoice referencing PO RWI-2025-7783.

Once we have confirmation we'll finalize the procurement record and move the PO from provisional to active status.

Thanks,
Chloe

From: Jill Torres <jill.torres@dropframe.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO issued: provisional PO RWI-2025-7783 (please confirm SKU & acceptance of spend cap)

Hi Chloe, Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and for issuing the provisional PO. Confirming the following:

- DropFrame accepts PO RWI-2025-7783 and the $45,000 spend cap for the initial period.
- We will invoice under SKU DF-PRE (premium) as per the SOW. Attached is an amended invoice that lists DF-PRE line items and references the PO number.
- COI is attached as well.

Attachments: invoice_dropframe_20250712.xlsx (XLSX), DropFrame_COI_2025.pdf (PDF)

Please let us know the AP contact and the payment terms (we previously proposed net-45).

Best,
Jill

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Torres <jill.torres@dropframe.io>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-12T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO issued: provisional PO RWI-2025-7783 (please confirm SKU & acceptance of spend cap)

Hi Jill — confirmed receipt of amended invoice and COI. AP contact for Redwood is ap@redwoodinference.com and our payment term on approved POs is net-45. We will route this through accounts payable once procurement marks the PO active; you should receive payment within terms after invoice verification.

Closing the loop here — Marcus, please update PROC-4821 to move PO RWI-2025-7783 to active and record DF-PRE as the billed SKU.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
